purpose: Aggregate release-readiness review for the requested workspace/project restoration, simulation recovery, readiness, library management, diagnostics, RMSD/RMSF and chemistry support changes. Assess bounded local software behavior and native numerical consistency only; do not promote biological accuracy, universal chemical coverage, protonation populations, coordination energetics, affinity or converged dynamics.

reproducibility.hardware: Local Apple Silicon CPU; native AmberTools and OpenMM Reference/CPU; no cloud or GPU compute
reproducibility.budget: At most 12 unique ligand native parameterizations, 10-minute timeout per native command; <=20-step chemistry numerical-continuity simulations; recovery fixtures up to 400 OpenMM or 3,000 GROMACS steps to reach a checkpoint before interrupt/cancel/resume; existing curated PTM parity fixtures; no long production MD

inputs.matrix: Standard residue templates/protonation variants/termini/disulfide; SEP,TPO,PTR,HYP; neutral alcohol/aromatic, anionic carboxylate/phosphate, cationic amine, ATP/ADP/NAD/FAD; Na/Cl/K/Mg/Ca; expected rejection of unsupported elements, radicals, missing ligand atoms, covalent inhibitors/cofactors and unregistered amino acids. MSE/ALY only if compatible published parameters and native parity can be established.

reproducibility.actual_compute_scope: Representative native chemistry fixtures use five 0.2-fs Reference-platform steps. Native recovery script uses 400 OpenMM and 3,000 GROMACS production steps; separate actual-browser OpenMM recovery uses 500 steps. Additional bounded legacy UI workflows are described in their reports. No production convergence study.
reproducibility.source_hash_scope: Source snapshot used for this aggregate report; not a signed packaged release. Native per-case provenance retains the exact code/runtime hashes used by each native fixture.

data.policy: Preserve identities, elements, all deposited heavy atoms and stereochemistry; no parent-residue mutation, arbitrary GAFF on covalent proteins, fabricated parameters or silent removal. Keep view/identity/preparation/native-check status separate. Explicitly disclose fixed protonation assumptions and nonbonded ion limitations. Resume must preserve topology/system/config/platform compatibility and retained coordinates. RMSD/RMSF use documented selections, alignment/reference, units and handling of periodic boundaries.

validation.status: Recorded bounded software and native numerical checks passed; scientific accuracy and production convergence remain unvalidated

notes: This is the latest-per-test union of separate runs, not one monolithic run of all tests on one source revision.
The preparation rejection case was renamed to its intended readiness replacement and is counted once; old failures remain in history.

Historical product hashes were not captured. Report hashes authenticate the evidence bytes; current source hashes describe the final source snapshot only and are not assigned retroactively to earlier runs.
Final layout/workspace/readiness/native-complex and structural-analysis checks were rerun on index-YBadVVti.js; early cancellation cases were rerun after the supervisor fix.
Native recovery continuity is a software check on short trajectories, not proof of equilibration, convergence or bitwise reproducibility.

analytical_checks: Proper rigid rotation/translation removal without reflecting chirality
Independent MDTraj comparison on nondegenerate perturbed coordinates
Known RMSD/RMSF and residue variance aggregation
Periodic box crossing and source-coordinate preservation
Invalid fit groups/frame windows and timestamp-axis fallback
review_findings_resolved: Malformed non-finite diagnostic step caused an uncaught OverflowError; step/time validation and regression added
Non-increasing imported timestamps could collapse the endpoint-scaled plot domain; explicit saved-frame axis and warning added
CSV alone omitted calculation provenance; companion JSON analysis record added
Legacy cancellation cases exposed a cancelled worker being classified as interrupted; persisted cancellation marker is now respected after exit, with backend and native UI regressions
validation.test_design: Iterative implementation/regression testing, with initial chemistry failures retained. Not a blind benchmark, not an experimental comparison, and not a prospective study.
limitations: Representative chemical fixtures are not an exhaustive applicability-domain study
Five-step vacuum numerical tests do not validate aqueous dynamics or equilibrium
Fixed ligand/PTM protonation and nonbonded ion models are assumptions, not experimentally validated populations or coordination energetics
Unregistered unnatural residues, organometallics, covalent ligands/cofactors, radicals and incomplete/ambiguous graphs remain explicitly unsupported
Prepared complex/PTM/ion state transfer to GROMACS remains unsupported
Native Quit-menu clicks were not exercised because the desktop was locked
Public bundle signing/notarization, clean-machine verification and complete redistribution materials remain separate packaging acceptance work
Large-trajectory streaming was not part of the requested additions; existing caps remain

comparison.notes: Deterministic software/numerical checks do not establish meaningful uncertainty intervals for scientific accuracy. No comparative efficacy/affinity or convergence claim.

review_identity: Language-model code and evidence review with an automated PatAgent checklist; not expert certification or Pat Walters endorsement.

modeling.scope: Checkpoint/file continuity and native parameter transfer, not converged production dynamics.

blog_context.coverage: Complete cached public corpus at the recorded sync, not exhaustive access to paywalled writing
blog_context.application: Applying general representation/provenance/benchmark principles to this MD software audit is this language model review’s inference.

review_tool.scope: Checks audit/parser behavior; not molecular-science validation.
